The prior owner authorization does not remove the operator's runtime fences: a live run still requires a FRESH external index proof, the six phase-scoped variables in the process environment, and proof of the exact staging project ref before a client is constructed.

resolved_blocker.now: A closed typed contract in lib/communication/businessTemplateVariables.ts declares each binding explicitly and its named pure builders are the only accepted construction path. The manifest records the same bindings, and the seed operator requires both authorities to agree exactly.
resolved_blocker.proof: npm run test:mvp:40-12-r1 exercises the real builders and the real renderWhatsAppTemplateComponents — a manifest edit alone cannot satisfy it.

honest_scope.note: The five business templates are CONTRACT-READY, not TRIGGER-WIRED. No automation was enabled and no live caller was created; the builders exist so that the future caller and the mapping row cannot disagree about variable names.

next_action: Produce a fresh index proof by direct read-only SQL and point QF_STAGING_INDEX_PROOF_PATH at it (outside the repository); it expires in 15 minutes, so generate it immediately before the run. runtime_repair.was: The operator was a scaffold: after its fences it ran an unconditional PREFLIGHT_NOT_SATISFIED refusal, so --preflight-readonly and --execute could never do anything.
runtime_repair.now: Both modes are real and reachable. No bypass flag was added; the refusal was replaced by the runtime it stood in for.
runtime_repair.cross_process_design: Each npm run is a separate process, so an in-memory preflight flag would be meaningless. --preflight-readonly writes a sanitized, single-use, 15-minute attestation OUTSIDE the repository pinning head, branch, project ref, manifest / readiness / binding-contract hashes, the eight keys, schema and index proofs, the Meta reconciliation, the mapping plan, the account classification, a nonce and a digest. --execute reruns the FULL read-only preflight and requires the stored attestation to match it on every pinned field before any write.
runtime_repair.writes_bounded: At most two: the disabled account and one bulk insert of only the missing mappings. Any error or ambiguous result is WRITE_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN and is never retried.

tests.result: 167 passed, 0 failed (51 rules, 38 mutation self-tests, 39 runtime tests, 39 R3 tests)
tests.isolation: No test contacts Supabase or Meta; every effect is an injected fake.

index_proof.was: The adapter always returned INDEX_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE, so a live preflight could never get past it.
index_proof.independent_finding: Direct read-only SQL against the staging project proved both required indexes exist with the exact definitions the seed depends on.
index_proof.now: That finding is NOT hard-coded and is NOT a permanent exception. The operator consumes a FRESH external proof at QF_STAGING_INDEX_PROOF_PATH, produced out of band by direct read-only SQL, verified for artifact/environment/project/table/source, digest, expiry (max 15 minutes), no future-dating, exactly two entries with exact names, uniqueness, ORDERED columns and predicate, and a path outside the repository. The verified hash is pinned into the attestation and re-verified by --execute.
index_proof.no_schema_change: No RPC, DDL, migration or SQL function was added.

meta_semantics.was: The adapter requested only name,language,status,category and then returned semanticMatch:true unconditionally — asserting something it had no basis for, and waving through exactly the body-drift case the check exists to catch.
meta_semantics.now: It requests components as well and compares the remote row against the approved creation_payload using the EXISTING templatesAreIdentical / canonicaliseTemplate from the submission operator. No weaker duplicate comparator was written. It fails closed when components are absent or more than one template matches. Still GET-only.

whole_set_scan.was: Only the exact (key, language, version) tuple was classified, so an active row on another version or language, a duplicate tuple, an extra non-canonical row, a populated provider_template_id or a non-approved row were all invisible.
whole_set_scan.now: scanMappingSet() scans every row for the eight keys before anything is classified, attested or written, and aborts on any of those. Post-write readback requires exactly one row per key, exactly eight rows in total, and exact canonical language, version, name, category and variables_schema.

r3_repairs.internal_templates: verifyInternalTemplates() now requires all eight keys, no duplicate row per key, language en, and a non-empty canonical version.
r3_repairs.attestation: Stored/fresh comparison additionally pins schema_proof, index_proof_hash, runtime_policy_non_sendable and the full meta_reconciliation.
